projects.descZh: Urban Oasis 是一套以亲生物体验为核心的多感官交互疗愈系统。作品将园艺训练、感官刺激与交互反馈整合为可拓展的训练流程，用于促进心理健康与感官能力的提升，并支持在不同空间与场景中部署与扩展。
projects.descEn: Urban Oasis is a multi-sensory interactive therapeutic system grounded in biophilic experience. It integrates horticulture training, sensory stimulation, and interactive feedback into an extensible training workflow designed to support psychological well-being and strengthen sensory abilities across varied spaces and contexts.

projects.subtitleZh: 信息可视化 / 书籍设计
projects.descZh: 本书探讨“量化自我”的理念，“量化自我”是一种通过数据衡量和管理自己的生活方式，它可以帮助人们更好地了解自己，并做出更明智的决策。利用可视化编程生成数字化艺术图像，并通过新媒体软件艺术加工。结合数字艺术与新媒体艺术，创造出全新艺术形式来表达“量化自我”。
projects.descEn: Quantified Self Book translates personal data into a readable narrative through information visualization and editorial design, exploring how data can become a medium for self-awareness and self-management.

projects.descZh: 该项目受唐诺曼博士理念启发，专注于满足老年群体的深层情感与自尊需求。我意识到，对老年人而言，设计的价值不仅在于功能的便利和实用，更在于对其情感、独立性和个人尊严的尊重与维护。因此该系统深度融合智能科技，减轻老年旅客体力负担，配备智能导航系统，确保他们与行李准确、高效送达登机口。同时，注重满足老年人的无差异化体验，尊重其自尊需求。外观设计现代时尚，采用高品质材质，旨在满足“新老人”的现代审美与自尊心理，让他们在享受便捷服务的同时，感受到社会的尊重与关怀。
projects.descEn: Inspired by Dr. Don Norman’s philosophy, this project focuses on addressing older travelers’ deeper emotional needs and sense of dignity. It recognizes that the value of design for seniors lies not only in convenience and practicality, but also in respecting and protecting their emotions, independence, and personal dignity. The system integrates intelligent technologies to reduce physical strain, and includes smart navigation to ensure both travelers and their luggage reach the gate accurately and efficiently. It also emphasizes an inclusive, non-stigmatizing experience that honors self-esteem. With a modern, refined form and premium materials, it is designed for the “new seniors” who seek contemporary aesthetics and dignity—so they can enjoy convenient service while feeling respected and cared for by society.

projects.descZh: 在2024年3月，以“自然生长”为主题，为四川农业大学艺术与传媒学院毕业设计展进行了主视觉设计。选取植物形态作为视觉元素，直观体现“自然生长”的核心概念。考虑处于艺术与科技深度融合的时代，决定融入编程逻辑，赋予视觉表达科技感。在动态效果上，模拟了一个出现、运动、消散的自然生命周期。为实现这一目标，在梳理编程逻辑后，采用了多个控制按钮，以调整“移动”、“旋转”、“消散”等不同的数据参数。通过这种方式，成功实现了一种流畅而自然的动态效果，使得整个设计作品更加生动且富有生命力，从而更好地体现了“自然生长”的主题。
projects.descEn: In March 2024, I created the key visual for the graduation exhibition of the College of Art and Media at Sichuan Agricultural University under the theme “Nature Growth”. Plant-like forms were chosen as the core visual elements to directly communicate the concept. To reflect the era of deep integration between art and technology, I introduced generative logic to give the visual a contemporary, tech-forward tone. The motion design simulates a natural life cycle—emergence, movement, and dissipation—controlled by multiple parameters such as translation, rotation, and dispersion. The result is a smooth, organic animation that makes the key visual vivid and full of vitality.
